Package glit.service

Class Repository

java.lang.Object
glit.service.Repository
public class Repository extends Object

Core class responsible for managing the Glit repository.

Provides functionality to initialize a new repository, locate an existing one within the directory tree, and perform basic path and file state evaluations.

    • whereIsRepo

      public static Path whereIsRepo()

      Locates the root path of the closest Glit repository.

      This method traverses upwards from the current working directory, searching for a directory that contains the hidden .glit folder.

      Returns:
      the Path to the repository root directory, or null if no repository is found

    • init

      public static void init() throws IOException

      Initializes a new, empty Glit repository in the current working directory.

      Creates the mandatory internal directory structure (e.g., objects, refs), default files (e.g., HEAD, config), the binary index file, and a default .glitignore file. If a repository already exists in the current or parent directories, the initialization is aborted to prevent overwriting.

      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while creating directories or files

    • add

      public static void add(Call cliCall) throws IOException
      Method that adds files to index. If file is not staged yet, it will be added, if it is staged but changed since last staging, it will be updated, otherwise it will be left unchanged. If file is ignored, it will be skipped. If no files are added, method will return with info.
      Parameters:
      cliCall - - the object containing parsed command-line arguments
      Throws:
      IOException

      Parameters:
      cliCall - the object containing parsed command-line arguments

    • commit

      public static void commit(Call cliCall) throws IOException
      Method that creates new commit with files staged in index. If there is no commit in head, all staged files will be commited as new files, otherwise they will be compared to files in head and marked as modified, new or deleted. After commit, index should be cleared.
      Parameters:
      cliCall - - the object containing parsed command-line arguments
      Throws:
      IOException

    • status

      public static void status()
      Checks and displays the current state of the repository (equivalent to 'git status'). *

      This method informs the user about:

      • The current active branch (or detached HEAD state)
      • Changes staged for commit (Changes to be committed)
      • Changes tracked but modified locally (Changes not staged for commit)
      • Untracked files in the working directory

    • log

      public static void log()
      Traverses the commit history backwards, starting from the current HEAD state. Prints the content metadata of up to 10 recent commits by following parent hashes.

    • branch

      public static boolean branch(Call cliCall)
      Handles branch management operations (equivalent to 'git branch').

      Operates in two distinct modes depending on provided arguments:

      1. No arguments: Scans and lists all existing branch reference files in refs/heads, highlighting the currently active branch with a leading "*" symbol.
      2. One argument: Creates a new branch reference file pointing to the current commit, ensuring first that a branch with the requested name does not already exist.
      Parameters:
      cliCall - the object containing parsed command-line arguments

    • checkout

      public static void checkout(Call cliCall) throws IOException
      Switches branches or restores working tree files (equivalent to 'git checkout').

      If the -b flag is provided in the command line call, this method first creates a new branch and then switches to it. Otherwise, it switches to an already existing branch and updates the working directory to match the target branch's latest commit.

      Before performing the checkout, the method enforces strict state validations to prevent accidental data loss. The operation will be aborted if:

      • There are tracked files with unstaged modifications in the working directory.
      • There are files staged in the index that have not yet been committed.

      Note: Branch names containing slashes (e.g., feature/login) are currently not supported and should be avoided.

      Parameters:
      cliCall - the object containing parsed command-line arguments and flags
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while reading repository paths, comparing file states, or updating the HEAD reference
